course_name: 深度學習與物聯網應用
outline:
1.深度學習介紹，2.監督式學習，3.無監督式學習，4.物聯網，5.感知層，6.網路層，7.應用層，8. 深度學習與物聯網應用實例。
1. Introduction to Deep Learning, 2. Supervised Learning, 3. Unsupervised Learning, 4. Internet of Things, 5. Perception Layer, 6. Network Layer, 7. Application Layer, 8. Deep Learning and Internet of Things
schedule:
Week 1-2.        Introduction to Deep Learning
week  3-4         Fundamental of Internet of Things
Week 5-6.        Neural Network Architectures
Week 7-8.        Convolutional Neural Networks
Week 9-10 .     Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs)
Week 11-12.    Image classification and Object detection
Week 13.         Generative Models
Week 14          Transformers & Attention
Week 15-16.    Application of Deep learning for Internet of things
Week 17-18.    Final project presentation

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
flexible_learning.content:
Final Project online Presentations:

Students will develop a practical project integrating deep learning and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. They will implement and evaluate models using suitable datasets or IoT sensor data, analyze results, and present their projects online in group through demonstrations.
flexible_learning.outcome:
Students will be able to:

_ Apply deep learning techniques to solve practical IoT problems.

_ Implement and evaluate deep learning models using appropriate tools and datasets.

_ Analyze experimental results and assess model performance.

_ Present project findings online and communicate technical ideas effectively.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio:
The flexible learning activities account for 30% of the final course grade.

Assessment methods: Project implementation, final report, online oral presentation, and demonstration .

assessment:
Assignments : 40 %
Labs / Mini Projects: 20 %
Attendance : 10 %
Final Project : 30 %
